description: What SMSParser should extract from each sample message. All messages are synthetic look-alikes of real formats documented in docs/sms-samples.md. Amounts are strings so tests can build exact Decimal values. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; hasTime=false means the app should use the time the SMS arrived.

cases.sms: A transaction of SGD 48.20 was made with your UOB Card ending 1234 on 05/03/26 at Cafe Lumiere. If unauthorised, call 24/7 Fraud Hotline
cases.tests: Basic SGD purchase; DD/MM/YY date is day-first (5 March, not 3 May).

cases.sms: A transaction of SGD 125.00 was made with your UOB Card ending 9876 on 21/03/26 at SMP**AB. If unauthorised, call 24/7 Fraud Hotline
cases.tests: Merchant is a payment-processor code with asterisks; a second card on the same phone.

cases.sms: A transaction of SGD 2,345.80 was made with your UOB Card ending 1234 on 14/02/26 at HOTELSITE.COM HOTEL SUNRISE. If unauthorised, call 24/7 Fraud Hotline
cases.tests: Thousands comma removed from amount; merchant contains a dot, so it must not be cut at the first full stop.

cases.sms: A transaction of HKD 1,856.30 was made with your UOB Card ending 5555 on 09/01/26 at HARBOUR VIEW HTL HK,KOWLO. If unauthorised, call 24/7 Fraud Hotline now
cases.tests: Foreign currency kept as-is (no conversion in the parser); merchant contains a comma; message ends with 'now'.

cases.sms: A refund of SGD23.40 from SHOPMART.COM has been made to your UOB card ending 1234 on 12 Mar 2026. The refund will be posted in your next statement
cases.tests: Refund stored as a negative amount; no space in 'SGD23.40'; 'DD Mon YYYY' date; lowercase 'card'.

cases.sms: Your parcel is out for delivery and will arrive today.
cases.tests: No bank rule matches: the parser returns nothing, so the app falls back to AI extraction (if a key is set) or a needs-review entry. Generic made-up text, not a bank format.
